summary: BioHarvest Sciences filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated October 8, 2026, announcing a development milestone in its next-generation sweetener programme with Tate & Lyle PLC. The release states the Botanical Synthesis platform can produce the targeted sweetening solution, building on an expanded May 2026 collaboration. No financial terms, equity stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. The item is ordinary business and research-and-development progress, not a special situation. Traders should monitor further Tate & Lyle collaboration updates for potential commercial milestones rather than deal-driven arbitrage.
